# GeniusCFO — full reference for language models

> GeniusCFO is accounting automation software for Indian businesses and CA firms. It automates
> routine bookkeeping, prepares GST information and financial statements, and answers financial
> questions from updated accounts. Operated by GeniusCFO, serving India.

## What GeniusCFO is

GeniusCFO is a web application (BusinessApplication / accounting software) used on desktop and
phone. It is built for Indian businesses that run their own books and for chartered accountancy
and vCFO firms that run books for client companies. It is not a filing portal and it does not
replace professional judgement: firms review prepared entries and retain final sign-off.

## What GeniusCFO does

- Automates routine bookkeeping and journal entries.
- Prepares GST information, including output GST, input tax credit, net payable, due dates and
  mismatches, and GSTR-3B information.
- Prepares financial statements: Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement,
  Notes to Accounts and Trial Balance.
- Matches bank transactions against accounting entries (bank reconciliation).
- Answers typed or spoken financial questions from updated accounts ("Ask GeniusCFO").
- Shows sales, profit, cash, receivables, payables, working capital and cash runway on one
  dashboard, with alerts on GST, receivables and runway.

## Pricing

All prices are in Indian rupees and exclude 18% GST. The GST-inclusive total is shown against the
selected plan. Billing is monthly or every three months; the three-month option is billed once for
three months of access and costs 20% less than the monthly rate. Every plan begins with a 7-day
trial with full access. Business plans start with a one-time ₹9 payment on Razorpay, after which
the visitor signs up and the 7 days begin; CA/Firm plans start with a free trial after a demo booked with the GeniusCFO team. No UPI mandate is set up and nothing is
charged automatically after the trial. The ₹9 charge exists because a free trial attracted fake
sign-ups that used up the AI credits meant for trials. After the trial the customer chooses
a plan and pays via Razorpay; if they do not, the AI stops while books, statements, GST screens and
manual entry keep working and nothing is deleted.

Plans for a business running its own books (one company, one user):

| Plan | Monthly | Every 3 months | Per month on 3-month billing | 3-month total incl. 18% GST |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Light | 999 | 2,398 | 799 | 2,830 |
| Pro | 1,999 | 4,798 | 1,599 | 5,662 |
| Pro Max | 2,999 | 7,198 | 2,399 | 8,494 |

Plans for CA and vCFO firms, priced by client companies and team members included:

| Plan | Scope | Monthly | Every 3 months | Per month on 3-month billing | 3-month total incl. 18% GST |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Team | 3 client companies, 2 extra members | 3,999 | 9,598 | 3,199 | 11,326 |
| Enterprise | 10 client companies, 5 extra members | 6,999 | 16,798 | 5,599 | 19,822 |

Add-ons, charged per month on top of any plan: extra team member 299, extra company profile 599.
For firm plans these are described as additional client company 599 per company per month and
additional team member 299 per member per month.

Managed accounting services for business customers, billed separately and not included in any plan:
Accountant+ 999 per month and CA+ 2,999 per month. These services are for business customers,
not for CA/Firm plan holders.

Every plan carries the full product — books, GST, TDS, ITR, unlimited workflows and the
Intelligence Hub. Plans differ in the AI allowance, the level of support, and how many companies
and members are covered.

The website does not sell plans directly. Business pricing actions lead to the ₹9 trial payment on
Razorpay and then to sign-up; CA/Firm pricing actions book a demo with the GeniusCFO team. Plans are chosen and paid for inside the product after the trial.

## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for business owners
Source: https://geniuscfo.ai/business

### What does GeniusCFO do for a business?

GeniusCFO automates bookkeeping, prepares GST information, matches bank transactions, shows important business numbers and alerts, and answers financial questions from updated accounts.

### Do I need accounting knowledge to use GeniusCFO?

No. Business owners can see clear dashboards and ask questions in everyday English. Your accountant or CA can review the accounting entries and source records.

### Can I ask GeniusCFO questions by voice?

Yes. Ask GeniusCFO accepts typed or voice questions about profit, cash, GST and other financial information in the books.

### Does GeniusCFO prepare GST information?

Yes. GeniusCFO uses updated books to prepare GST information, including output GST, input tax credit, net payable, return status and mismatches for review.

### Can I use GeniusCFO on my phone and laptop?

Yes. GeniusCFO works on phone and desktop, so you can check business numbers, alerts and answers wherever you are.

### Can my accountant or CA review the same books?

Yes. Your accountant or CA can review the entries, source records, reports and GST information in the same accounting workspace.

### What does the ₹9 trial include?

Seven days of full access to everything - bookkeeping, GST information, bank matching, alerts and Ask GeniusCFO - on your own books. You pay ₹9 once on Razorpay, sign up, and start the same day. There is no UPI mandate and nothing is charged automatically afterwards: at the end of the 7 days you choose a plan, and if you do not, the AI stops while your books, statements and GST screens keep working.

### Why does the trial cost ₹9?

Because a free trial brought in fake sign-ups and people who worked through the AI credits meant for trials without any intention of using the product. A small payment keeps the trial for real businesses and keeps the AI allowance available to them.


## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for CA and accounting firms
Source: https://geniuscfo.ai/ca-firms

### What accounting work can GeniusCFO automate?

GeniusCFO automates routine bookkeeping entries, prepares GST information, financial statements and accounting reports, supports bank reconciliation, and keeps source references available for review.

### Can my team review entries before sign-off?

Yes. Your team can review the prepared entries and their source records. Your firm keeps professional judgement and final sign-off.

### Which financial statements can GeniusCFO prepare?

GeniusCFO prepares the Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement and Notes to Accounts. Trial Balance is available as a separate accounting report.

### How does GeniusCFO help with GST?

It brings GST liability, input tax credit, mismatches and prepared GSTR-3B information into the client workspace for review.

### Can I use voice input?

Yes. You can type a financial question or use voice input in Ask GeniusCFO.

### How are CA/Firm plans priced?

Firm plans are priced by the client companies and team members included. Team covers three client companies and Enterprise covers ten. Additional client companies are 599 rupees per month each and additional members are 299 rupees per month each. Monthly and 3-month billing are available.

### How does the firm trial work?

Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial with full access from day one. No credit card or UPI mandate is required to begin.

### Do CA/Firm plans include Accountant+ or CA+?

No. Those managed accounting services are for business customers. CA/Firm plans are for firms that provide accounting and professional services to their own clients.


## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO pricing
Source: https://geniuscfo.ai/pricing

### How long is the trial?

Every plan starts with a 7-day trial with full access from day one. Businesses pay ₹9 once on Razorpay to start and sign up straight after; CA/Firm plans start with a free trial after a demo booked with the GeniusCFO team. No UPI mandate is set up and nothing is charged automatically after the trial.

### Why does the business trial cost ₹9?

Because a free trial brought in fake sign-ups and people who worked through the AI credits meant for trials without any intention of using the product. A small payment keeps the trial for real businesses and keeps the AI allowance available to them. CA/Firm trials begin with a booked demo, so they stay free.

### What happens after the trial?

You choose a plan and pay via Razorpay. If you do not, the AI stops - your books, statements, GST screens and manual entry all keep working, and nothing is ever deleted.

### How does 3-month billing work?

The 3-month option is billed once for three months of access and saves 20% against the monthly rate. Monthly billing is available on every plan.

### What is the difference between the plans?

Every plan includes the full product - books, GST, TDS, ITR, unlimited workflows and the Intelligence Hub. The tiers differ in how much AI you get, the level of support, and how many companies and members are included.

### Can I change my plan later?

Yes. Contact the GeniusCFO team to move to a different plan. The new plan and billing amount will apply from the confirmed change date.

### Is GST included in the displayed prices?

No. Plan prices exclude 18% GST. The total including GST is shown against the selected plan, and GeniusCFO provides a GST tax invoice for the billed amount.

### Are managed accounting services included in a plan?

No. Accountant+ and CA+ are optional services for business customers and are billed separately.

### How are plans for CA firms priced?

Firm plans are priced by the client companies and team members included. Team covers three client companies and Enterprise covers ten. Additional client companies are 599 rupees per month each and additional members are 299 rupees per month each.

## Terms used

- GST — Goods and Services Tax, the indirect tax applied in India. GeniusCFO prices exclude 18% GST.
- Input tax credit — GST paid on purchases that can be set against GST collected on sales.
- GSTR-3B — the summary GST return filed by registered taxpayers in India.
- TDS — Tax Deducted at Source. ITR — Income Tax Return.
- Schedule III — the Companies Act, 2013 format for financial statements.
- CA firm — a chartered accountancy practice. vCFO — virtual or fractional CFO practice.
- Razorpay — the Indian payment gateway used to collect plan payments.

## Blog

Index: https://geniuscfo.ai/blog

### The AI Was Looking at Your Ledger Through a Screenshot.

Canonical article: https://geniuscfo.ai/blog/through-the-glass
Published 11 September 2026. Analysis, not narrative and not a customer result.

The question: what does it cost to have an AI computer-use agent operate accounting software through its
screen, and is that the right place to put the intelligence?

A demonstration put a model in front of TallyPrime and had it record a receipt by voice — reading an overdue
receivables report, then opening a receipt voucher and allocating a payment against a named bill. The
engineering is real and is credited as such. Two objections follow.

The cost. An agent driving a screen runs a loop: capture the screen, reason about the pixels, act, capture
again. Every capture is an image and every image is billed as input tokens. Posting that one receipt takes
about 25 passes. Costed at published list prices — $10 per million input tokens, $50 output, $1 cached, a
Tally screen capture at roughly 1,500 tokens, the last two captures retained in context, and USD/INR at 95.12
on 9 September 2026 — the components are: screen captures and working context 125,000 tokens at $1.25; system
prompt and tool definitions 62,500 cached tokens at $0.06; reasoning and actions 6,250 output tokens at $0.31;
and 2 min 49 sec of realtime voice audio at $0.14. Total 193,750 tokens, $1.76, or 168 rupees for one receipt
on the first attempt. At 98% reliability per step a 25-step task lands first time about 60% of the time, and a
failed run still bills for the steps it completed, which puts the figure nearer 278 rupees per completed
entry. At 400 entries a month that models to 67,000-1,11,000 rupees in model cost alone. Every one of these
numbers is a modelled estimate from published list prices under the stated assumptions, not a measured bill.

The architecture, which is the larger half of the argument. Three problems are structural rather than
commercial, so cheaper tokens do not remove them. First, cost scales with entries rather than with the
business: a better month, with more invoices in it, costs more to record. Second, the agent waits to be asked,
so nothing notices a customer crossing ninety days or a GST mismatch appearing unless somebody thinks of the
question. Third, an agent driving accounting software is procedurally a user with the same reach as anyone
holding the mouse, and it leaves a saved voucher rather than a proposal somebody reviewed before it was
booked.

The alternative put forward is to place the AI underneath the ledger rather than in front of it. GeniusCFO
does not drive accounting software: the accounting engine is the product, with real double-entry and
sub-ledgers, and GST, TDS, TCS, reverse charge and import duty inside the posting itself rather than applied
afterwards. Documents go in — around fifteen Indian document types, including scans and phone photographs —
and booked entries come out, at a fixed monthly price rather than a charge per action. The article concedes
that models and captures will get cheaper and that this arithmetic will look different in two years, while
holding that neither the waiting-to-be-asked problem nor the somebody-else-already-wrote-the-books problem is
a pricing problem.

Computer-use agent, as defined in this article: a language model that operates existing software the way a
person does, by capturing the screen as an image, reasoning about the pixels and sending keystrokes or clicks.
Because every pass through that loop bills a fresh image, its cost scales with the number of entries recorded
rather than with a subscription.

Sources cited on the page: GPT-6 Astra on OpenRouter; CloudZero's GPT-6 pricing breakdown; OpenAI's images and
vision guide; Layer3 Labs' realtime API pricing guide; Contra Collective on computer-use agents in production;
Trading Economics for USD/INR. GeniusCFO plan pricing is as published at https://geniuscfo.ai/pricing and
excludes 18% GST. Third-party products and models are named for comparison and remain the property of their
owners.

### Every Invoice Looked Fine. Together, They Told a Different Story.

Canonical story: https://geniuscfo.ai/stories/every-invoice-looked-fine

A fictional restaurant story about food-cost movement across ordinary supplier invoices. Current books connect the movement to posted purchase entries, so the owner can ask a specific question. The owner and Chartered Accountant retain commercial judgement, review and sign-off. Meera, Coastal House, its suppliers and every financial figure are fictional; this is not a customer result or a promise of savings. Read the canonical story for the full narrative and closing disclosure.

### Nobody Warned You the Business Came With a Second Job.

Canonical story: https://geniuscfo.ai/stories/the-second-job

A fictional garment-unit story about the unpaid finance job an owner inherits as the business grows. A supplier payment, a GST payment and payday fall in the same week while a customer invoice is uncleared. Because the books are kept current every day rather than caught up at month-end, the Intelligence Hub flags a cash gap eighteen days out — 6,40,000 rupees of supplier payment and GST landing before the customer invoice clears — with the posted entries attached to the alert. The alert makes the collision reviewable; it does not make the commercial decision. Professional review and sign-off stay with the Chartered Accountant. Harpreet Singh, the unit, its suppliers and every financial figure are fictional; this is not a customer result or a promise of savings.

The lag, as defined in this story: the time between something happening in a business and the books being able to show it. It does not make the answer wrong; it makes the answer late.
